text.en: In the Saru, Chitose, and Mukawa dialects, the personal affixes *ku=* and *ci=* contract to *k=* and *c=* respectively before vowel-initial verbs or nouns, specifically before stems beginning with *a*, *u*, *e*, or *o* ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--ku-ci-contraction-saru-chitose⟧⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-the-saru-chitose-and-mukawa-dialects-personal⟧⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-western-hidaka-and-chitose-dialects-k-u⟧. In Western Hidaka and Chitose dialects this process is described as the dropping of *u* and *i* from *k(u)=* and *c(i)=*, with the remaining consonant fusing with the following syllable ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-western-hidaka-and-chitose-dialects-k-u⟧. Nakagawa 2024 further reports that in most dialects outside Saru, Chitose, and Mukawa the contraction does not occur and the two-syllable forms are retained ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--except-in-saru-chitose-and-mukawa-dialects-the⟧. Satō 2008 states more generally that the first-person singular nominative prefix *ku-* becomes *k-* before vowels other than *i*, with the accent shifting to the vowel syllable of the stem ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-first-person-singular-nominative-prefix-ku-becomes⟧, and that the exclusive first-person plural transitive nominative prefix *ci-* likewise becomes *c-* before vowels with the accent shifting to that syllable ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-exclusive-first-person-plural-transitive-nominative-prefix⟧.
text.ja: 沙流・千歳・鵡川方言では、人称接辞*ku=*および*ci=*は母音始まりの動詞または名詞の前でそれぞれ*k=*および*c=*に縮約し、具体的には*a*・*u*・*e*・*o*で始まる語幹の前でこの現象が生じる⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--ku-ci-contraction-saru-chitose⟧⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-the-saru-chitose-and-mukawa-dialects-personal⟧⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-western-hidaka-and-chitose-dialects-k-u⟧。日高西部・千歳方言においてはこの過程が*k(u)=*・*c(i)=*からそれぞれ*u*・*i*が脱落し、残った子音が後続音節と融合するものとして記述されている⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-western-hidaka-and-chitose-dialects-k-u⟧。中川2024はさらに、沙流・千歳・鵡川を除く大部分の方言では縮約が起こらず2音節形が保たれると報告する⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--except-in-saru-chitose-and-mukawa-dialects-the⟧。佐藤2008はより一般的な記述として、一人称単数主格接頭辞*ku-*は*i*を除く母音の前で*k-*となりアクセントが語幹の母音音節に移動すると述べ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-first-person-singular-nominative-prefix-ku-becomes⟧、除外的一人称複数他動詞主格接頭辞*ci-*も同様に母音の前で*c-*となりアクセントがその音節に移動すると述べる⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-exclusive-first-person-plural-transitive-nominative-prefix⟧。

text.en: When *ku-* occurs before the vowel *i* followed by a single consonant, the *i* becomes *y* and the accent shifts from *i* to *u*, yielding the surface form *kúy-* ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--when-ku-occurs-before-the-vowel-i-followed⟧; the verb *ipe* 'to eat', for instance, surfaces as *ku-ype* after the first-person singular prefix ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-verb-ipe-to-eat-becomes-ype-after⟧. The second-person singular prefix *e-* undergoes the same process before an initial *i* followed by a single consonant, with *i* becoming *y* and the accent shifting to *e-* ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--when-the-second-person-singular-prefix-e-attaches⟧. The middle-voice and nominalizing prefix *ci-* loses its vowel *i* before *a* and *o*, paralleling the morphophonology of the first-person plural prefix *ci=* before those vowels ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-middle-voice-nominalizing-prefix-ci-loses-its⟧.
text.ja: *ku-*が単一子音を後続させる母音*i*の前に立つと、*i*は*y*となりアクセントが*i*から*u*へ移動して表層形*kúy-*が生じる⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--when-ku-occurs-before-the-vowel-i-followed⟧。たとえば動詞*ipe*「食べる」は一人称単数接頭辞の後で*ku-ype*として現れる⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-verb-ipe-to-eat-becomes-ype-after⟧。二人称単数接頭辞*e-*も同様に、単一子音を後続させる語頭*i*の前では*i*が*y*となりアクセントが*e-*に移動する⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--when-the-second-person-singular-prefix-e-attaches⟧。中動態・名詞化の接頭辞*ci-*は、人称接辞*ci=*と同様に母音*a*および*o*の前で*i*が脱落する⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--the-middle-voice-nominalizing-prefix-ci-loses-its⟧。

text.en: In Shizunai Ainu, when a pronominal affix occurs more than once with two closely connected verbals, its ellipsis is permitted though not required ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-shizunai-ainu-ellipsis-of-a-pronominal-affix⟧. Across word boundaries, an initial *yV-* sequence can drop *y-* after a consonant-final word, yielding a *-CV-* sequence ⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--across-word-boundaries-an-initial-yv-sequence-can⟧.
text.ja: 静内アイヌ語では、密接に関連する2つの動詞表現に伴って人称接辞が複数回現れる場合、その省略は義務的ではないものの許容される⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--in-shizunai-ainu-ellipsis-of-a-pronominal-affix⟧。語境界をまたいで、子音末の語の後では語頭の*yV-*連続から*y-*が脱落し*-CV-*という連続が生じることがある⟦claim:phon/personal-affix-sandhi-connected-speech-reduction--across-word-boundaries-an-initial-yv-sequence-can⟧。
